description:
USB/IP client for Windows

USBip is a USB/IP client for Windows that attaches USB devices shared by a remote USB/IP server over TCP/IP, so they appear as locally connected devices.
It is fully compatible with the Linux USB/IP protocol, ships WHLK-certified UDE and filter drivers, uses Winsock Kernel NPI for low latency and high throughput, and includes both a GUI (wusbip) and a command line client (usbip).
- This release is the result of an AI-assisted code review of the solution
- Google Gemini 3.8 Flash served as the primary tool for code analysis and generation, while Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 was used as a supplementary analysis tool.
- This process resulted in 100 commits containing numerous fixes and improvements.
- Due to the significant volume of changes, there is a possibility of regression errors.
- Currently, none of the AI models detect any issues within the solution.
- The installer has been substantially improved. The dependency on the 32-bit UninsIS.dll library has been dropped, and newly added Pascal functions are now used instead of shell scripts to perform most actions.
